summary: Kate Knibbs / Wired: A look at AI news website RuntimeWire, which costs $100/day to run and “beat” human reporters to OpenAI's Black Hat disclosure, favoring quantity over quality — Last week, an AI newsroom beat mainstream journalists—including WIRED—to a story about OpenAI and hacking. contentText:
Kate Knibbs / Wired :

A look at AI news website RuntimeWire, which costs $100/day to run and “beat” human reporters to OpenAI's Black Hat disclosure, favoring quantity over quality   —  Last week, an AI newsroom beat mainstream journalists—including WIRED—to a story about OpenAI and hacking.  It's just the beginning.
